description: Create an HTTP request file named 'api-tests.http' in the workspace root (/home/ga/workspace/api_test/) to test a REST API. The file must include: (1) A variable definition '@baseUrl = http://localhost:3000', (2) A GET request to '{{baseUrl}}/api/users' with 'Accept: application/json' header, (3) A POST request to '{{baseUrl}}/api/users' with 'Content-Type: application/json' header and JSON body containing fields 'name' (value: 'Test User') and 'email' (value: 'test@example.com'), (4) A GET request to '{{baseUrl}}/api/users/1', (5) Use '###' separators between requests. The exact format should follow standard .http file syntax with variable references using {{variableName}} syntax.
